verdict.rationale: Square's docs explicitly document Tap to Pay on iPhone for accepting contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets in person, plus Terminal API support for tip collection at checkout, and Mobile Payments SDK for chip/contactless via hardware readers. Community commentary corroborates real-world merchant use of Square hardware for in-person card acceptance. Missing for 10: explicit mention of Google Pay support in-person and independent hands-on verification of contactless/chip reliability beyond older magstripe-era anecdotes.
